name: mirage
text: Found one likely cause and fixed it in code: when the first score feed listed other games for the day but not yours, the other feeds (ESPN, PropLine) were never asked. They are now. ESPN does have the DET/CHA game as final, so it should grade once this ships. Tests pass. It is not released yet; it goes out with the next release. If bets are still open after that, the bet's grey note tells me why.
